title: Microsoft 365: Control access to Learning Activities and Teach
summary:
IT administrators can manage access to Learning Activities and Teach from the Microsoft 365 admin center. Configure Learning Activities separately for educators and for students ages 13 and older and enable or disable Teach for educators to align AI experiences with your organization's policies and deployment readiness.
GA date: September CY2026

title: Microsoft 365: Assign Different Content to Learning Groups in a Single Assignment
summary:
Enable educators to assign different content (attachments, resources, instructions) to different Individual Groups within a single Assignment. Today teachers must create separate assignments to differentiate — one for advanced readers, another for struggling students, etc. This feature collapses that into one assignment with group-specific content mapping.
Key capabilities:
Map different content to different Individual Groups within one Assignment
Students only see content assigned to their grou

title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
summary:
Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice
GA date: August CY2026

title: Microsoft Edge: Work Search Banner for Google
summary: When a user performs a search on google.com from a work profile, Microsoft Edge can detect whether organization-specific results are available for that query. When relevant results are found, a banner is shown with a link to explore those work results with Microsoft 365 Copilot. This builds on the existing experience already available on Bing and extends it to Google, helping users seamlessly access work-related information regardless of their search engine. Admins can control access to this fea

title: Microsoft Edge: Security Update Alerts in the Edge management service
summary:
Administrators can choose a severity threshold and receive alerts when a new Edge update includes security fixes that meet or exceed that level, including zero day fixes. This helps organizations quickly identify updates that may require attention, while avoiding unnecessary notifications for routine releases.
GA date: August CY2026
Preview date: April CY2026

title: Microsoft Edge: Auto-open Copilot side pane for Outlook links
summary: When users open links from Outlook, Microsoft Edge can automatically open the Copilot side pane to provide contextual insights and actionable suggestion chips based on email and destination content - such as highlighting key points, and recommending next actions - without disrupting the browsing flow. This experience helps users quickly understand content, take action with fewer steps, and get more value from Copilot while extending productive browsing time in Edge. Admins can control availabili

title: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Autofill
summary:
For desktop users, Microsoft Edge can now autofill additional document types—including passports, driver’s licenses, and other specialized forms—on top of your saved addresses.
GA date: September CY2026

title: Microsoft Edge: Tracking prevention when browsing InPrivate
summary:
Microsoft Edge is unifying the tracking prevention experience for non-InPrivate and InPrivate browsing windows. Microsoft Edge will use the same tracking prevention setting as a normal browsing window when in InPrivate mode.
GA date: August CY2026

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents
summary:
Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents.
GA date: August CY2025

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents
summary:
Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents.
GA date: August CY2026

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-M will able to use custom engine agents
summary:
Users in GCC-M will be able to use custom engine agents.
GA date: August CY2026

title: Microsoft Viva: Discussion Post Previews
summary:
Discussion post previews allow users to review how their discussion posts will appear before publishing, helping them catch formatting issues, validate content, and post with greater confidence.
GA date: August CY2026

title: Microsoft Teams: Mandatory pre-meeting consent
summary:
We are providing a new configuration experience in Teams Admin Center where tenant admins can enable and customize an explicit consent message before joining any meeting hosted in their organization.
GA date: September CY2026

title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting archive for knowledge retention
summary:
Admins can enable a tenant-wide policy that allows Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after transcripts expire. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting archive is stored.
GA date: September CY2026

title: Microsoft Teams: Run SMB admin tasks faster with Microsoft 365 Admin Agent in Microsoft Teams
summary:
We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience. SMB Admins can use Microsoft 365 Admin Agent in Microsoft Teams to complete common admin tasks and get guidance on critical setup actions. Admin Agent can add users and assign licenses on behalf of the admin, as well as provide guidance on key SMB related topics such as organisation setup, security settings, and password resets—without leaving the Teams interface.
GA date: August CY2026

title: OneDrive: Improved max path error experience on desktop
summary:
OneDrive desktop sync users now get clearer, more actionable guidance when file paths exceed the supported 520-character limit. The updated experience shows exactly how many characters a path is over the limit and offers a guided flow to rename or move the affected items so they can sync.
GA date: September CY2026

title: Outlook: Clear & Flag Actions in New Outlook
summary:
We’re introducing new rule actions in the new Outlook for Web and Windows to give users greater flexibility and control. This includes Clear Categories, Clear Flag, Complete Flag, and Flag Message, enabling more precise automation of message organization and follow‑up workflows. #newoutlookforwindows
GA date: February CY2026

title: Outlook: Expanded Conditions for Conditional Formatting in the New Outlook for Web and Windows
summary:
The new Outlook for web and Windows now offers expanded Conditional Formatting options, allowing you to highlight emails based on size, read/unread status, presence of attachments, flag settings, categories, or importance. These enhanced rules make it easier to identify critical messages at a glance and visually organize your folders. #newoutlookforwindows
GA date: January CY2026

title: Microsoft Edge: Import Google account data anytime from Settings
summary:
Microsoft Edge now lets users import their Google account data - including passwords, bookmarks, history, and autofill data - directly from Edge Settings, at any time after setup. Previously, users had no way to import this data from a Google account outside the first-run experience. With this update, the import flow is unified into a single, streamlined entry point in Settings that combines import from Google Chrome import and Google account.
GA date: August CY2026

title: Microsoft Viva: Rolling out Custom branding in Engage
summary:
Engage is rolling out Custom Branding, a new admin-led capability that lets organizations define a customized, tenant-wide visual identity across the Engage web and mobile apps. Engage-level admins can configure a brand name, add large and small logos, and a theme color that is applied consistently for all users in the tenant. Branding is managed from the new Brand Center in the Viva Engage admin center and helps organizations reinforce their identity throughout the Engage experience.
GA da

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Dashboard - Targeted Audience Surveys
summary:
Targeted Audience Surveys let change leaders launch a Copilot Pulse survey directly from the Copilot Dashboard to all licensed or active users. Audiences update automatically using Insights data and respect existing dashboard filters like organization and job function, with privacy protected through population-level reporting only. Pair adoption metrics with employee sentiment in just a few clicks.
GA date: September CY2026
Preview date: August CY2026

title: SharePoint: Viva Connections multi-home site management moving to SharePoint admin center
summary: Viva Connections multi-home site management is moving from the Microsoft 365 admin center (MAC) to the SharePoint Admin Center (SPAC). Administrators will be able to create and manage multiple Home sites, configure audience targeting, manage home site priority order, and remove Home sites directly from SPAC. Existing entry points in the Microsoft 365 admin center will direct administrators to the new SPAC experience. As part of this update, legacy Viva Connections (VC) instances and draft/enable

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
summary:
We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.
GA date: October CY2026
Preview date: September CY

title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image
summary:
Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.
GA date: September CY2026

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Loss Prevention to safeguard sensitive information from external web search in Microsoft 356 Copilot and Copilot Chat
summary:
We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard web searches containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data for external web search.
GA date: July CY2026

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated Copilot Answers
summary:
Copilot Answers in Copilot Search (in the M365 Copilot App on web and desktop) will provide more concise responses and more prominently highlight the ability to continue in the conversation in Copilot chat on the right-hand sidebar.
GA date: July CY2026

title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
summary:
Teams Rooms on Windows users can now benefit from next generation IntelliFrame features on certified AI-capable cameras with on-device video processing. With IntelliFrame’s expanded AI data channel, participants experience faster active speaker framing, people recognition and labels, and more responsive meeting views—even when network conditions are limited. These capabilities are available with Teams Rooms Pro.
GA date: September CY2026

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts for government clouds
summary:
We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from returning a response when prompts contain sensitive data or using that sensitive data for grounding in Microsoft 365 or the web.
GA date: June CY2026

title:
Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person
meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
summary: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
summary: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Windows
summary:
When a Teams Rooms on Windows acts as an organizer, co-organizer or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.
GA date: October CY2026

title: Microsoft Teams: User uploaded custom background images for the new VDI solution for Microsoft Teams
summary:
With this new feature, users on the new VDI solution for Teams can blur their background, choose a Teams virtual background, or replace their background entirely with any image they want by uploading it through the "Video effects and Settings" option.
GA date: April CY2025

title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars
summary:
Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters can chat privately in a separate chat from attendees. This chat is available to access before, during, and after the event.
GA date: September CY2026

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - SLA Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
summary:
Out-of-box MTTA/MTTD/MTTR SLA Alert Reporting dashboard showing past trends, Top SITs getting exposed via DLP alerts generated. Customers can define their custom SLAs for high, med and low severity alerts and get access to dashboard showing operational performance and SLA metrics.
GA date: September CY2026
Preview date: August CY2026

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Rule-based tagging and auto-resolution of alerts based on business needs of the customer.
summary:
Alert auto-resolution & tagging rules let you tell DLP, in advance, how to handle predictable alerts. You define a rule once, and from then on DLP applies it automatically to every new alert: ● Resolve alerts you don't need to see - e.g., Low-severity alerts for mail sent only to your trusted partner domains, so they never reach your triage queue. ● Tag alerts so you can find and route them - e.g., label every alert from your Legal department as a “Business Process”.
GA date: September CY20

title: Outlook: Copilot Chat pop-out for Outlook for Mac and iPad
summary:
Copilot Chat remains accessible within an Outlook app window but now can also be popped out to float over the main Outlook app window. Popping out Copilot Chat allows people to switch contexts or have more space for what they are working on in Outlook and control the space and form that Copilot Chat takes on screen. When you open Copilot chat and click the pop-out button, Copilot will open separately over the main Outlook window.
GA date: August CY2026

title: Outlook: Drag and Drop
summary:
You can now reschedule events by dragging them to a new time slot in your calendar. This feature is available in day and multi day views.
GA date: August CY2026

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
summary:
Apply sensitivity labels to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups to extend the classification and governance you already use for Microsoft 365 groups. The same labels you publish in the Microsoft Purview portal and configure for groups and sites apply automatically to cloud security groups, with no separate label configuration required.
GA date: August CY2026

title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
summary:
AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.
GA date: September CY2026
Preview date: August CY2026

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Rich Answer Cards
summary:
Surface new model-driven, dynamically placed Answer Cards across top 7 segments: weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news for Entra & MSA users across all surfaces.
GA date: August CY2026

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Workforce Insights Agent
summary:
Workforce Insights (WFI) Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot is an agent designed to help leaders, managers, and their delegates quickly understand their organization by turning complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights. With WFI Agent, leaders can quickly explore their organization’s structure, team composition, skills inventories, and flexible work patterns to move from insight to action in a single, unified experience directly in Copilot or Teams.
GA date: September CY2026

title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live Light theme support
summary:
Presenting PowerPoint slides in Teams just got better. PowerPoint Live now supports light mode, giving presenters the option to present in light, dark, classic, or high contrast mode based on their preferences and system settings.
GA date: September CY2026

title: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
summary:
The updated Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android prioritizes video on the meeting stage, arranges participants in consistent aspect ratios, and minimizes movement of participant tiles on stage. Users can hide the room self-preview video and choose to see audio and video participants equally on stage, instead of prioritizing video participants. Admins can choose the default behavior using local device settings and the Pro Management portal.
GA date: August CY2026

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
summary:
Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph. The goal is to give users a single, seamless Archive view, even though Archive data may physically reside across multiple auxiliary mailboxes with EWS Graph APIs getting deprecated by OCT 2026.
GA date: October CY2026

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Azure PST Import
summary: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes. It follows the standard two‑step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration. The process also involves creating a migration endpoint, running an analysis-only migration batch, using the analysis results to configure the final batch, and then starting the

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Outlook Emails in Copilot Notebooks
summary:
Outlook Emails as References in Copilot Notebooks bring email content into the notebook experience, enabling users to ground Copilot in the conversations, decisions, and context that drive their work. By adding emails as knowledge sources, users can connect context from their emails directly to their projects, enriching notebooks beyond files alone and improving downstream outputs like presentations and briefs. Available in Copilot Notebooks across Microsoft 365.
GA date: July CY2026

title: Microsoft Teams: Manage Built-in Teams agents in the Teams admin center
summary:
Admins will be able to manage Teams built-in agents across core Teams experiences, including chats, channels, and meetings, through a dedicated experience in the Teams admin center. From a centralized location, admins can control agents’ availability for users and groups. These agents will be enabled by default for licensed users and managed independently from org-wide Microsoft app settings.
GA date: July CY2026

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for MCP Agents with Interactive UI Widgets in Government Clouds
summary:
Feature description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will now be able to surface rich, interactive UI widgets directly within chat. This enhancement enables developers to deliver more engaging and structured agent interactions. Users will experience these widgets when interacting with agents that implement them, and admins will continue to manage these agents through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.
GA date: August CY2026

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Archive OneDrive and SharePoint files under retention
summary: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage,

title: Microsoft Teams: Join Google Meet meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows
summary:
Organizations now have expanded meeting interoperability with two-way Direct Guest Join (DGJ) between Google Meet and Teams meetings. Teams Rooms on Windows devices can join Google Meet meetings, and Google Meet devices can join Teams meetings. Users can join with one click through the calendar or by meeting ID. This capability is now available for both Commercial (Feb 2026) and Government cloud environments.
GA date: July CY2026

title: Overage enforcement
summary: When consumption exceeds available capacity, the environment is in overage. Microsoft allows some level of overage consumption, similar to a grace period, to avoid blocking business processes.

title: Enforcement policy
summary: Applies to all tenants operating under the Copilot Studio prepaid capacity model for custom agent usage (conversational and autonomously triggered).

title: Usage threshold
summary: Enforcement is triggered when a tenant reaches 125% of their prepaid capacity.

title: Action on overage (125%)
summary: Custom agents are disabled. Disabling an agent doesn't interrupt an ongoing conversation. All subsequent attempts to invoke the agent are rejected until capacity is increased or reset.

title: Notification mechanism
summary: An email notification is sent to the tenant's designated administrator and the notification is also posted in the Power Platform admin center.
